items.headline: capSpire posts strong growth on ETRM demand
items.summary: Per CTRM Center, capSpire is experiencing a strong year of growth, supported by two strategic acquisitions, expanding demand for ETRM services and AI initiatives among trading firms.

items.headline: IFC and Citi launch $2bn trade finance facility
items.summary: IFC and Citi announced a $2bn trade finance facility to expand access to financing for companies in Africa, Asia and Latin America, with IFC providing guarantees of up to $1bn matched by Citi over three years.

items.headline: ACER issues updated REMIT reporting manual
items.summary: ACER published TRUM v8.0 and related REMIT reporting guidance, including updated XML schemas and exposure reporting rules, reflecting the revised REMIT II implementing framework.

items.headline: Freight forwarder adds AI assistant connector
items.summary: Freight Right launched a Model Context Protocol connector enabling shippers to quote, track, book and manage freight shipments directly through AI assistants such as Claude.
